title: Remote mountain hamlets reap direct rewards ______ hosting international trekkers.
subtitle: from

questions.en: Remote mountain hamlets reap direct rewards from hosting international trekkers.

questions.hint: reap benefits/rewards from + nguồn: thu được lợi ích hoặc thành quả từ nguồn đó.
